subject: phone consults at aurora
body:
Hi Dana,

Your consult page asks people to call to book their free skin consult, and you're closed Sunday and Monday. When you're the one injecting, a caller with a laser question on a Monday hears voicemail and usually tries the next clinic.

I build an AI receptionist that answers those calls, covers the common pre-consult questions and books the consult. There's a live demo you can call like a client would: +1 (555) 010-0100.

Worth a reply if it sounds useful?

the operator

personalization_evidence.fact: Call to book your free skin consult

unverified_assumptions: that calls go to voicemail when Dana is with a client
